name: akriunit
description: Lightweight and beginner-friendly JS unit testing based on PHPUnit workflow
author: Raiyen "JM" Janszen

scripts.test-seq: node ./src/cli.js tests failTest && node ./src/cli.js tests test && node ./src/cli.js tests srcTest && npx akriunit tests test && npx akriunit tests srcTest && npx akriunit tests failTest
scripts.fulltest: npm run test-dist && npm run test-src && npm run test-seq
